title: Darwinism
description: Darwin’s Serum adapts to your environment and actions, giving you exactly what you need to survive in real time.
body: Darwinism adds a tiered potion effect that makes your body respond to the world around it. Sprint long enough and you accelerate. Take damage and regneration kicks in, amplifying itself as you keep getting hurt. Step into darkness and your eyes adjust. Three tiers of increasing power, each one harder to brew and further from human limits.
